_about: The gate cell's questions (tools/gate_cell_same_request.py). A gate question is one where the model CHOOSES at every step: its vendor top-2 margin (transformers, the rendered prompt with the pinned date, the container's dtype, the logits after the model's own scaling) is at least the floor at every decoded position (`gate_cell_same_request.py --check-question`). The run sends the `gating` entries in order and never gates an OPEN entry; the open red is the open entry with "pinned": false (no system message: the template renders today's date). A status follows the measures; the Mac measures are a probe, the gate's card (V100) measures are to be added by the same command.
units: vendor logit units (the logits transformers returns, after granite's logits_scaling); one bf16 step near 24 is 0.125
